name: Deniz Yilmaz
bio:
Deniz's path to motorsport was unconventional, beginning with a deep fascination for mathematical modeling and simulations. While pursuing a degree in engineering, he became engrossed in optimizing race car setups using computational fluid dynamics. This led to an internship with a small Formula 3 team, where he quickly proved his ability to predict race outcomes based on data analysis. He joined Ipiranga Racing three years ago, bringing a fresh perspective to race strategy. 

Deniz approaches his role with meticulous precision, constantly seeking innovative ways to gain a competitive edge. He is known for his ability to identify subtle shifts in track conditions and anticipate competitor moves, enabling the team to make timely and impactful decisions. While sometimes perceived as aloof due to his intense focus, his insights have consistently translated into podium finishes for the team. Deniz's distinctive ability to translate complex data into actionable race strategies sets him apart.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave.
physical.description: Deniz is of average height with a lean build and intense, focused eyes.

quirks: Always carries a Rubik's Cube and solves it during brief moments of downtime.
Refuses to drink anything other than strong Turkish coffee before a race.
Mumbles complex equations to himself when under pressure.
